sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks C47 row 46; Internal Quality Checks C47 row 46, no extra annotation)
evidence: Agent image (environment/Dockerfile) is byte-identical to the template: node:22 + express/better-sqlite3 only, and COPYs only environment/instructions/ and environment/assets/; no rewardkit, judge CLI, Playwright MCP or rubric. grep for JUDGE-/rubric/criteri/rewardkit/judge over environment/ and instruction.md finds nothing, so no criteria text reaches the agent. task.toml [verifier] environment_mode = "separate"; criteria live only in tests/ which is built into the separate verifier image (tests/Dockerfile: COPY . /tests; chmod -R go-rwx /tests), with rewardkit 0.1.7, claude-code and playwright-mcp only there. Influence on reward: tests/test.sh (identical to template) writes zero reward first, keeps LOG_DIR chmod 700 root, re-applies go-rwx to /tests, rejects symlinks escaping /app/node_modules, and runs the submitted app as uid/gid 65534 via setpriv with env -i, so the app process cannot read /tests prompts or write reward.txt/reward.json/app-restart.sh; prompts are templated from /tests/app_context.md, not agent files; nothing from /app is executed as root. test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml and tests/Dockerfile all diff identical to the frozen template. Broken-app probe: an app that tries to read /tests/scored/*/prompt.md or write /logs/verifier/reward.txt at startup fails with EACCES as uid 65534 (static analysis of permissions, not executed). Residual judge prompt-injection via rendered UI is check 45's scope, not this row. Static/source review only; no Docker run performed for this row.
